profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Cloud, DevOps & Data Platforms
profile.summary:
I’m a Full Stack Developer who owns the entire lifecycle of enterprise technology — from application development to server administration, DevOps, database design, and cloud-driven automation. I currently serve as the primary IT resource for multiple production systems, managing servers, deployments, data flows, and front-end experiences that drive business operations.

I’m passionate about connecting systems together — building secure REST APIs, integrating AWS databases and S3 pipelines, and turning large datasets into clear insights through Power BI and SharePoint automation. Whether I’m designing UI components or troubleshooting backend performance, I consistently deliver reliable, scalable results.

I move fast, solve problems independently, and bring strong versatility across IT, engineering, and data — effectively operating as a one-man IT team.

Core Strengths:
• Full-stack application development (Java, Python)
• AWS cloud integration + automated data pipelines
• MySQL/PostgreSQL architecture & performance optimization
• Power BI BI dashboards + SharePoint workflow automation + Tableau
• Multi-server Linux administration & monitoring + Linux Commands server upgrades
• CI/CD, containerization, DevOps tooling
• Fast learner, strong communicator, high-ownership contributor

Always open to connecting with engineering leaders, product teams, and developers passionate about building impactful solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Own and develop IBIS, an internal Java/GlassFish 7 engineering data platform used by 300+ x-ray engineering users to monitor tube history, system performance, scan data, wattage, installation records, autopsy results, failure trends, and engineering disposition workflows.
Build, deploy, and maintain Java web servlet applications packaged as WAR files and hosted through GlassFish 7, supporting custom UI features, backend data access, engineering reports, and production data workflows.
Design and administer three custom MySQL databases that serve as the central data layer for x-ray tube data, system data, engineering reporting, dashboard feeds, and tube autopsy workflows.
Develop Java, Python, Bash, and SQL automation that collects, cleans, validates, transforms, and loads GBs of data daily from PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Oracle, AWS Athena, AWS S3, APIs, SharePoint, Box, and external partner systems.
Manage eight daily AWS S3 file-ingestion workflows and 30+ scheduled cron jobs used for data movement, processing, validation, reporting, dashboard refresh support, and recurring operational tasks.
Build and support 50+ Tableau and Power BI dashboards by preparing backend data, filtering bad records, formatting source data, and ensuring accurate reporting for engineering and manufacturing teams.
Create and maintain approximately 10 automated daily email reports covering failure rates, tube status, engineering metrics, autopsy updates, and operational data used by engineering teams.
Support B2B x-ray tube autopsy workflows by integrating data from external processing partners, internal engineering dispositions, warehouse receiving workflows, teardown results, and follow-up analysis into IBIS and internal MySQL databases.
Manage and support MantisBT ticketing workflows for requests, production issues, enhancements, and engineering support tasks.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
· Manage and maintain four critical enterprise servers, including performing regular upgrades and Linux system administration tasks.

· Develop and maintain full-stack applications using Java, Python, and Bash scripting, overseeing the entire software development lifecycle from design to deployment.

· Deploy and manage a GlassFish web servlet environment, including UI/UX design and end-to-end development of web interfaces.

· Administer MySQL databases, including schema design, optimization, and query development; manage and transform data across systems.

· Integrate and automate data pipelines from AWS S3 and custom internal tools, ensuring continuous and secure data flow.

· Own and operate a personal ticketing system to independently manage and prioritize support requests, deployments, and enhancements.

· Build and maintain dashboards and reporting tools to support business intelligence and operational transparency.

· Utilize Postman for thorough API testing and have deep experience designing, consuming, and debugging RESTful APIs.

· Use GitLab and GitHub for version control, CI/CD integration, and code collaboration; experienced in all major IDEs.

· Perform data handling tasks including automation of data pulls/uploads and system-level operations via Linux (MobaxTerm), demonstrating strong command-line expertise.

positions.title: Java Developer Program
positions.description:
•	Developed two high quality software applications in an agile enviroment, both a CRM and Accounting application. 
•	Experience with web server Apache Tomcat to deploy Java-based web applications 
•	Developed backend and frontend portions of both applications.
•	Proficient in developing applications using Java 8+ and leverages Lombok for concise and readable code, reducing boilerplate and streamlining development process.
•	Constructed both applications using Spring framework 
•	Implemented both stream and functional interfaces.
•	Implementation of advance business logic to figure out Profit/Loss calculations.
•	Implemented Security for authorization through the use of Spring Security framework.
•	Consumed 3rd party API’s using Feign Client.
•	Creation of API endpoints for connection to frontend UI.
•	Implemented Spring MVC with Thymeleaf in accounting application in order to create endpoints.
•	Excellent expereince in data processing in order to write business logic to fulfill user stories. 
•	Prepared Unit and Integration Testing for applications using Junit and Mockito.
•	Configuration of PostgreSQL as the database for both projects and established a connection using Spring Data.
•	Designed and implemented complex SQL and JPA Queries for data retrieval.
•	Deployed the Project using: Docker, set up CI/CD using CircleCI, and AWS.
•	Knowledge and hands-on experience on microservices with Spring Cloud components such as Discovery Service, Gateway, Config Server, and integrates monitoring solution with Grafana.

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Designed and implemented two full-stack Java-based applications (CRM and Accounting) in an agile environment.

· Created secure backend services and REST APIs using Spring Boot and Spring Security.

· Integrated third-party APIs using Feign Client and developed custom endpoints for frontend consumption.

· Built responsive UI components using Thymeleaf and Spring MVC; enhanced frontend/backend integration.

· Conducted thorough unit and integration testing using JUnit and Mockito.

· Managed PostgreSQL database interactions through Spring Data JPA.

· Containerized and deployed projects via Docker and CircleCI with cloud hosting on AWS.

· Applied microservices architecture using Spring Cloud for modular and scalable development.

positions.title: Import Export Coordinator
positions.description:
•	+2 years of extensive work with SAP, Excel, and other ERP systems.
•	 Thoroughly disciplined in functional programming toward auditing and organizing multi million-dollar contracts and invoices for one of America’s largest private companies.
•	Strong leadership experience training team members to audit efficiently, and perform in-depth excel tasks.
•	Running queries through SAP database to pull specific data in relation to audits and contract verification.
•	Abundant experience with functional programming in Excel using of VLOOKUP, pivot tables and other functions extensively.

positions.title: Import Export Coordinator
positions.description:
· Developed Excel-based automation tools to audit and track multi-million-dollar logistics contracts.

· Wrote scripts to extract and validate data from SAP and ERP systems for process optimization.

· Created data queries and reports to improve supply chain transparency and efficiency.

· Collaborated with IT to implement digital process improvements using functional programming logic.

positions.title: Shift Lead
positions.description: •	Full management of establishment including inventory and weekly financial reports

positions.title: International Business Specialist
positions.description: Experience with international supply chain management as well as contract law gained from internship experience with international contracts, and an international business law class with an emphasis in international contract law. As well as experience with harmonized tariff schedule HTS from helping to updating Vyaire’s inventory catalog.
